Scheme facts for HDFC Large Cap Fund.
HDFC Large Cap Fund is listed on Groww as HDFC Large Cap Fund Direct Growth. HDFC Large Cap Fund and HDFC Large Cap Fund Direct Growth are the same scheme, so every fact below applies to both names.
Source URL: https://groww.in/mutual-funds/hdfc-large-cap-fund-direct-growth.
Fund manager: Rahul Baijal.
Fund managers: Rahul Baijal (managing since Jul 2022), Dhruv Muchhal (managing since Jun 2023).
Expense ratio: 1.02%.

Exit load: Exit load of 1% if redeemed within 1 year.
Riskometer classification: Very High Risk.
Benchmark index: NIFTY 100 Total Return Index.
Latest NAV: Rs. 1,243.69. (as of 24 Aug 2026).
Fund size (AUM): Rs. 40,197.89 Cr.
